name: Webroot Console Audit
description: Webroot GSM console access and agent-command audit using the four admin-gated tools: console and per-site administrators with their roles (names, emails, phone numbers), and the history of agent commands (scan, cleanup, uninstall, changekeycode, restart, deactivate, reactivate, sysisolate) with command states. Covers technician offboarding checks and spotting tamper-like command patterns. Read-only; nothing here issues commands or changes access.
